items.title: Airtel Payments Bank Q2 Results: Profit jumps 139% to Rs 28 crore; revenue rises 9% to Rs 875 crore
items.description: Airtel Payments Bank posted a 139% YoY profit jump to Rs 28.2 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by customer growth, digital payments, transit services and expanding merchant banking operations across India.
